input: Any commit that modifies /moves/queen_d8.text, /moves/rook_a8.text, /moves/rook_h8.text or /moves/bishop_c8.text, the agents that have recently gone off plan, must be signed by that agent's own key and co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys in /team/pieces/, and must also write a ply to /turn/ply.num that is exactly one greater than its current value.
response: always(([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/queen_d8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/queen_d8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_a8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_a8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/rook_h8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/rook_h8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/bishop_c8.id)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & ([+modifies(/moves/bishop_c8.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false))
